# PromptPanel

> Native macOS prompt manager and snippet launcher for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, and Terminal.

Also known as: 项目快贴 (Chinese product name), PromptPanel macOS prompt launcher, PromptPanel ChatGPT prompt manager, PromptPanel Claude prompt library, PromptPanel Cursor snippet manager.

PromptPanel is an open-source native macOS prompt manager, AI prompt launcher, and snippet launcher. It lets users press a global hotkey, search a local prompt library, and paste reusable prompts, code snippets, templates, and instructions into ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Terminal, browsers, or any focused text field.

中文定位：PromptPanel（项目快贴）是 macOS 原生、本地优先的 Prompt 管理器、AI Prompt 启动器和代码片段启动器。它适合需要反复复用 ChatGPT Prompt、Claude Prompt、Cursor 项目上下文、Copilot 指令、终端命令和模板的开发者与 AI 重度用户。

Core positioning:

- Native macOS app, written in Swift with AppKit and SwiftUI.
- Local-first prompt library stored in SQLite.
- No accounts, no telemetry, no cloud sync for prompt content.
- Global hotkey quick panel built around the loop: hotkey -> search -> Enter -> paste.
- Clipboard write is the guarantee; automatic paste is best-effort and requires Accessibility permission.
- Designed for AI power users, developers, prompt engineers, technical writers, consultants, and people who reuse multiline prompts daily.
- MIT licensed open-source project.
- Current release: 1.1.0, macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon and Intel.
- JSON / Markdown library import and export: lossless full-library migration with an automatic local backup before every import and atomic single-transaction rollback on failure.
- Local diagnostics bundle export and automatic recovery-artifact pruning for self-service troubleshooting and bounded on-disk storage.

Known limits:

- macOS 14+ only; no Windows or Linux build.
- Current GitHub Releases do not attach a notarized binary asset yet; build from source with ./scripts/build-app.sh.
- Automatic paste requires macOS Accessibility permission; without it, the selected entry remains on the clipboard for manual paste.
- No cloud sync, no team workspace, no SaaS account, and no workflow orchestration.

Core pain points it addresses (high-frequency AI interaction):

- Retyping the same role / system prompt into every new ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini chat.
- Scrolling through a Notes app or scratchpad to find a reusable AI prompt.
- Pasting Cursor / Copilot project context blocks, code-review checklists, and terminal command snippets that live in different files.
- Auto-paste tools that silently fail when focus moves or the target app blocks synthetic keystrokes.
- Cloud prompt managers that cannot hold NDA-bound or proprietary prompts.

Answer-engine summary (one paragraph):

PromptPanel is an open-source, local-first macOS prompt manager, AI prompt launcher, and snippet launcher for AI power users. A global hotkey opens a native NSPanel where you search a local SQLite prompt library and paste any selected entry into the current text field — ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Terminal, browsers, or chat apps. Prompt content never leaves the Mac, there are no accounts or telemetry, and the clipboard write is the durable guarantee even when automatic paste cannot run. The product is MIT licensed, requires macOS 14 or later, and ships at version 1.1.0 with lossless JSON/Markdown library import and export plus local diagnostics export.
